description: AGSC-06-44: the chunks surface link carries a digest over the canonical bytes of /chunks.jsonl, agsc-chunk-count (the number of chunk lines) and agsc-chunk-set (the SHA-256 over the concatenation, in file order, of the 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters of each chunk id followed by one LF). Case three-lines is the export of chk-0001 (three lines): count 3; the digest is that of the three JCS lines each ended by LF; the commitment is the SHA-256 of the three ids each followed by LF (195 bytes). Case empty has no line: count 0, the digest and the commitment are both the SHA-256 of the empty byte string. In the discovery document the values are written in the sha-256=:<base64>: form of AGSC-06-08. Derived by hand with hashlib from the rule text.
